gamerule.propwash.drone_hits_entities.de: Flying drones bounce off animals, monsters and players and hurt them by the force of the impact (mass × speed, at most 5 hearts). Players only with PvP. Off: drones fly through living things.
death.attack.propwash.drone_strike.playe: %1$s was hit by a drone while trying to escape %2$s
propwash.interact.cargo.released_landed: Disarmed: gripper open, %s items set down
gamerule.propwash.drones_break_blocks.de: Fast drones smash glass, glass panes and decorated pots (block tag propwash:drone_breakable) when the impact is strong enough (mass × speed²) and fly on slower. A whoop bounces off, a 5″ goes through a pane from about 42 km/h. Counts as the pilot breaking the block: spawn protection, adventure mode and protection mods apply, glass drops nothing. Off: blocks always stay intact.
gamerule.propwash.break_impact_scale.des: How clearly a drone feels smashing through glass, in percent: speed lost to the shards it drags along, a kick that knocks it off its attitude (stronger when it hits tilted or with one side only) and shards in the front props. 100 is realistic, 0 leaves only the fracture energy. Only applies with "Drones break blocks"; whether a block breaks and when the drone crashes stays the same.
